summary: A rapid response team holds an orientation for laid-off workers explaining services and benefits.
realLife: A federal page says specialists gather workers' skills and needs, then hold orientation meetings on career counseling, résumé and interview workshops, unemployment insurance, training and health and pension questions. Workers are urged to use services while severance or benefits last.
sources: U.S. Department of Labor, Rapid Response page for workers facing layoffs: https://www.dol.gov/agencies/eta/layoffs/workers
inGame: Job-ended event followed by a notice of unemployment help; the game has no rapid-response record, so it needs: a local help office scene.
